description: This file is a BitBake include configuration file for setting machine-specific compilation options for PowerPC architecture, specifically for the 'ppce500v2' CPU. It sets optimization flags, ABI extensions, and architecture features based on features enabled in the build configuration.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature or value is present within a configuration variable.

methods.description: Filters a list of features or values based on a condition.
